---
name: Empirical test result
about: You tested one of the book's claims on a real device
labels: empirical, help wanted
---

**Which claim**: see the table in [VERIFICATION.md](../../VERIFICATION.md) (claims 1–6)

**Device, OS version and build**: model, exact OS build, and whether it is rooted or jailbroken

**What you did**: exact commands and code, so someone else gets the same result

**What happened**: the actual output or screenshots, not a summary

**Does it confirm or contradict the book?**

> These are the most valuable contributions to this repo. Six claims have no hardware
> evidence: two are untested, and four were tested only on an emulator or simulator.
> A result from a real phone either way is new information, and you will be credited in the chapter.
